note: Corrections made while importing the delivered model. The delivery files and the external masters stay unchanged.

two_sided_cards.reason: Thatch fringe teeth face both ways and some are doubled. Drawn double-sided, half of them are lit from behind and the doubled ones fight in depth. Each face is kept once and given an explicit back face, so the material can draw one side.

extended_rafters.reason: In the master and in the delivery the north and south rafters of the characters corridor stop 1.99 m short of the inner beam (Personajes_Viga_N and _S, centred at |z| 8.0 m) and end in the air under the thatch, just past the welcome room. Each end face is moved rigidly along its own rafter's slope until it rests on the beam. The east and west rafters, and the four that already reach the roof hips, stay as delivered. Plan convention, metres.

removed_pieces.reason: The owner approved on 18/10/2026 standing the Castle at real size in the characters courtyard, behind the arc of pedestals, instead of on the central pedestal. The central pedestal (earthen body, wooden top and band) is taken out of the delivered row of pedestals at import; the master and the delivery stay unchanged. Box in metres, model space.

pieces.where: Earthen body of the central pedestal (point punto.personajes.castillo, formerly pedestal_3).
Wooden top of the central pedestal.
Woven band around the central pedestal, whole object.

grounded_posts.reason: In the master and in the delivery the posts of the welcome room are modelled from 0.60 m up, the top of its stone plinth (Bienvenida_Zocalo_Piedra). The plinth stops at both doorways, so the two posts that frame the south door (the entrance) and the two that frame the north passage toward the characters room (after the tree of life) hang 0.60 m above the threshold and the passage floor, like a floating door frame. Their bottom faces are lowered to the floor; the other posts stand on the plinth and stay as delivered. Plan positions (x, z) in metres, model space.

Bienvenida_Estructura_Madera.001.where: South doorway of the welcome room (entrance) and its north passage toward the characters room.

coplanar_overlaps.reason: Faces of the delivered model that lie in the same plane as other faces and overlap them flicker in depth (z-fighting), worst at a distance on the headset. Found with the surface audit (plane tolerance 4 mm) and kept to the pieces a visitor can see: hidden undersides, faces above the eyes and faces inside solids are left as delivered. Where two faces overlap, the one listed in under (same side) or under_either_side (pieces drawn on both sides) is drawn and the overlapping part of the other is cut away at import; partly covered faces are split, and new corners keep the texture, lightmap and colour of the face they come from. Box colliders and the delivered bounds stay as they were. Floor bands that crossed at their corners get one mitre joint.
